RNZ Pacific FAQ

What frequency is RNZ Pacific on?
In the A-26 season RNZ Pacific is scheduled on 8 shortwave frequencies, including 6135, 7245, 7440, 9700, 11725, 13690 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 17675 kHz (4:59 pm – 12:58 am Eastern). For Europe: 9700 kHz (5:51 pm – 7:58 pm UTC+1).

Can I hear RNZ Pacific in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 17675 kHz (4:59 pm – 12:58 am Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does RNZ Pacific broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 6135 kHz at 16:51–17:58 UTC to Pacific; 7245 kHz at 10:59–13:58 UTC to WOc; 7440 kHz at 12:59–16:50 UTC to Pacific; 7440 kHz at 13:59–16:50 UTC to Pacific; 9700 kHz at 06:59–10:58 UTC to Pacific; plus 9 more.

Is RNZ Pacific on the air right now?
As of Saturday, September 26, 2026, 09:51 UTC, RNZ Pacific is scheduled to be broadcasting on 9700 kHz to Pacific. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
